official_documentation.title: AMD RDNA3.5 Instruction Set Architecture Reference Guide
official_documentation.finding: The guide specifies nearest-even float WMMA, internal DOT operations and a matrix FMA expression. These statements do not establish single rounding of the complete dot or a tighter relative-to-L1 coefficient.

conclusions: The existing2^-19 coefficient has no observed misses in these786432 finite generated dots. Tightening to2^-21 is falsified by515 exact integer comparisons;2^-22 through2^-27 have progressively more counterexamples.
The2^-20 candidate also has no observed misses, but this finite sample is not a proof of a universal hardware bound. No coefficient is changed.

The positive common-exponent family is exactly single-rounded in all65536 observed outputs. Signed common-exponent, cancellation and exponent-span families demonstrate that this finite special case cannot justify a general correctly-rounded native dot.

Only the arithmetic probe and its host tools/tests changed. The retained real-model stack, selectors, GB10 gates, package and public release remain unchanged. This diagnostic is neither inference acceptance nor product performance evidence.
